config.more_cobblemon_contents_league_ch: Server rules: edit the active League data pack under league-challenge/.
Level caps: match each League cap to a numeric tier in Cobbled Level Control. Client settings cannot override server caps.
Wild levels: edit wild_level in the data pack's leagues/active.json. Regions default to levels 10-83 and 64x64 blocks; Pokemon spawn 5-15 levels below the lower of the regional level and your cap.
Teams, trainers, rewards and appearances are replaceable data-pack definitions. Skins use local resource-pack textures.
Apply data packs with /reload (operator permission required). Invalid catalogs keep the last valid version; active runs keep their original teams.

message.more_cobblemon_contents_league_c: Our eyes met! That means a Pokémon battle!
Nice Pokémon you have there. How about a battle?
When trainers' eyes meet, they battle!
I was getting bored. Want to battle?
Sure, let's battle!
Maybe later.
I'm in the middle of another battle.
That's enough for today. See you around!
We just battled! Take a break and come back.
You don't have a Pokémon that can fight! Heal up first.
I'd better get going. See you around!
Your Pokémon look worn out. Want to rest a bit?
Yes, please!
I'm fine.
There, all better! Take care out there.
They're all full of energy! Drop by whenever they're tired.
Got a %1$s, by any chance? Trade it to me and I'll give you my %2$s!
rarer Pokémon
Let's trade
Let me check my PC
Maybe later
Bring %s to the front of your party!
You'll send this %s (Lv.%s)?
In return you get my %s.
I'll give back the %s it's holding.
Send it
Let me think again
Thanks! Take good care of this %s.
Sorry, I was hoping to ask %s for this one.
Huh, what was I going to trade... sorry, see you later.
Want to try a Pokémon quiz? Get it right and there's a prize!
Sure, ask away!
Maybe later
Correct! Not bad at all!
Received %s!
Oh, I forgot to bring the prize... sorry!
So close! The answer was... %s!
You already answered my question. I'll have a new one next time we meet!
Huh, what was I going to ask... see you later!
I picked this up on my travels. Want it?
Thanks!
I'm fine.
Received %s!
Huh, my bag is empty... sorry, next time!
Putting my gift to good use? Safe travels!
Trainer
Argh, I lost...! You're really strong.
No way! My Pokémon got beaten like that?
It stings, but I'll admit it. Great battle!
I win! Come back better prepared next time.
Heh, you're not quite ready to face me yet.
That was a good battle! Let your Pokémon rest up.

modmenu.descriptionTranslation.more_cobb: Progress through gyms, badges, ranks, the Elite Four and Champion battles. This MCC addon uses a dedicated terminal and GUI, with league rules defined by server data packs and level-cap integration.
trainer.more_cobblemon_contents_league_c: My rock Pokémon grew up in the mine. Take them lightly and you'll regret it!
Down to one. But rock doesn't break that easily!
We hold out to the end. That's what rock types do!
I lost… I never thought my rock would crack.
Good fight. You can go a lot further than this.
Not strong enough to break rock yet. Come back tougher!
Today you'll see how great grass Pokémon are! Ready?
My last one! Let's bloom all the way!
Grass gets right back up when it's stepped on!
Aww, I lost! You two are really growing fast!
Come visit again! I'll be in full bloom.
So close! Get some more sun and come back!
Oh, a challenger! Please enjoy my ghost Pokémon's stage to the very end!
Now the final act. The real highlight starts now!
Don't look away for a second!
Oh my, I've lost! What a wonderful stage that was!
Bravo! You have my applause!
That's all for today's show. See you at the next one!
Battles deserve to be taken seriously. I'm going all out from the start!
My last one… I can't back down now!
I'll show you everything I've trained for!
I lost… you're really strong.
I won't forget today. I need to train even harder!
Good match. Train body and mind, and come back!
The man who splits the waves has arrived! Let's go head-on!
No three-count yet! Final round!
Everything rides on this one hit!
Gwaaah! A clean loss! Total defeat!
Your fighting spirit's the real deal! My blood's boiling!
This round's mine! Get back in the ring anytime!
Wahahaha! My Pokémon are tempered like steel. Get past them if you can!
One left, eh. Steel only gets harder the more you hammer it!
Now, have a taste of real steel!
Wahahaha! I lose! You smashed right through me!
Even my boy could stand to learn from you.
You're not tempered yet. Take a few more blows and come back!
Fully fired up! Cool body, hot heart. Here I come!
My last one! Now's when I need my spirit most!
It's not over! Focus, focus!
Aaah, I lost! Your spirit was a cut above!
Battling someone like you gets me fired up too!
You were a bit short on spirit! Fire up for real and come back!
Finally, someone worth battling. Don't disappoint me.
My last one… now it's finally getting exciting.
I haven't felt tension like this in ages.
I lost… yeah, this is the battle I wanted.
Thanks. You got me fired up again.
That's not enough to give me a jolt. Come back stronger.
Bug Pokémon are beautiful and strong. You're about to feel it yourself!
My last one… but the real beauty starts now!
These wings haven't broken yet!
I lost… I can't deny how strong you are.
Go on to the next room. Someone stronger is waiting.
If you looked down on bug Pokémon, that's why you lost. Come again.
Welcome, dear. Don't think I'll go easy because I'm old. Ho ho.
My last one. The ground doesn't shake that easily, dear.
Now Grandma's getting serious.
Ho ho, I lost. You've grown up wonderfully.
Keep your footing firm and keep going.
You rushed a little. Catch your breath and come back.
You made it! Let's have a red-hot battle!
My last spark… and you know sparks are the scariest part, right?
I'm not out yet! Burn brighter!
Argh, I lost! When did I last burn this hot?
Take that heat all the way to the end!
You haven't caught fire yet! Get hotter and come back!
I'll set my book aside. Right now I want to focus only on our battle.
My last one. The ending isn't decided yet.
Let's turn to the last chapter of this story.
Splendid. You're far stronger than I expected.
That battle was more gripping than any book.
You haven't reached the ending yet. Please come again.
You came back a Champion. This time I'm holding nothing back.
One left. I'm not crumbling this time.
I'll show you to the end why rock endures.
Champion for a reason. You broke me completely.
Next time I'll have dug even deeper.
Even a Champion falls if they let their guard down. Come again.
The Key Stone's ringing… Tyranitar, let's dig beyond our limits!
I can't do this one with a smile. I'm going all out.
Last one. I won't lose until I'm pulled up by the roots!
There's nowhere left to fall back to.
…I lost. You've gotten so strong.
It stings, but I'll admit it. You were amazing.
I win this time. Being Champion doesn't earn you mercy.
Our bond's in full bloom! Even a Champion won't expect this form!
This stage is no rehearsal. I'm putting everything on it.
The final act. The curtain hasn't fallen yet.
I'm the star of this stage until the end.
…Splendid. You were the star of today's stage.
I'll remember this loss for a long time.
Today, the stage was mine. Come challenge me again.
The climax is here! Gengar, fill the stage with your new form!
I'm not who I was. I started my training over from scratch.
My last one. I won't fall this time!
I'll prove my training right here.
…I lost. But I got closer than last time.
Next time, I'll win for sure.
I won… this time my training was a step ahead.
Our training doesn't end here. Together, we'll break through our limits!
Facing a Champion gets my blood boiling! No time for showboating. This is for real!
Final round! It's not over until I'm out of the ring!
Everything I have left goes into this hit!
…A total defeat. No excuses.
Next time I'll step in the ring even stronger!
This round's mine! Champion or not, everyone's equal in the ring!
Gwahaha! Watch closely, crowd! Gyarados, turn this whole ring upside down!
A Champion now, are you? Then there's no reason to go easy. Full strength.
One left. This steel doesn't bend easily.
I've hammered this steel all my life. It holds to the end.
…I lost. That was a proper battle.
Worth as much as any day in the mine.
Even a Champion can't do much against steel. Come again.
Wahahaha! I'll temper this steel once more! Metagross, Mega Evolve!
No fooling around this time. I'm putting in everything to the very end!
My last one. Crumbling here wouldn't be real spirit!
Ice is hardest just before it melts!
…I lost. I really lost. That stings!
Next time I'll come with twice the spirit.
I won! This time my spirit was a cut above!
Maximum focus! Froslass, shine brighter than ice in your new form!
The Champion came to me. Today I'm serious from start to finish.
Last one. A battle like this, I'll enjoy until I drop.
The current hasn't been cut yet.
…Beaten completely. I'm out of words.
Thanks. Battling was fun again for once.
I win this time. Even a Champion can't get careless.
…Yeah. This is the jolt I wanted. Take every volt from the Key Stone!
A rematch with the Champion. This time I'll prove strength, not beauty.
My last one. Even with broken wings, I'm not backing down.
I'll show you how stubborn bug Pokémon can be.
…Lost again. You really are a Champion.
Go on ahead. But I won't forget this loss.
I win this time. Getting comfortable as Champion, are we?
Watch closely, Champion! This is the true beauty Scizor and I share!
So you're Champion now. Then this time Grandma is truly serious.
My last one. The ground holds firm to the end.
My blood hasn't run this hot in years.
…I lost. I'm so proud of you.
Never thought I'd get a battle like this at my age.
Even a Champion falls without firm footing, dear.
Ho ho, the earth has answered. Now let that hidden strength unfold.
Back as Champion! This time I'm burning everything I've got!
My last flame. A flame burns hottest right before it goes out!
I'm not ending it here!
…Burned out. Total defeat.
Never burned this hard before. Thanks.
My flames burned hotter this time! Come again!
Now the fire's really caught! Houndoom, burn it all down!
I won't open my book today. There's no room to look away from a Champion.
My last one. I'll write this ending myself.
I'll read your every move to the end.
…I lost. I never could read your moves.
That was a story no book has ever told.
This story ends in my favor. Do come again.
A chapter no book has told… Mega Evolution will rewrite the ending.
We meet again. Champion against Champion this time. I'm going all out from the start.
My last one. This is where the real battle begins.
I have no intention of losing yet either.
…I lost. You're truly amazing.
The title of Champion suits you better than me.
A great battle. But this time, I won. Come again.
Let's see how far our bond can reach, Garchomp. Mega Evolve!
Milo
You really know your Pokémon! Let's have a proper battle!
This won't end so easily! We're tough as weeds!
Our Grass-type strength has wilted... You're some challenger!
You're a sturdy sprout. Grow some more and come back!
Right, let's Dynamax! We'll uproot you where you stand!
I'm not the Milo from your Gym Challenge. I'll go all out!
Dig in! We'll uproot even the Champion before we're done!
Our Grass power wilted again. You're a brilliant Champion!
Going all out was worth it! What a cracking battle!
We're giving it everything! Grow till you fill the stadium!
Nessa
Show me how far you can make it against my current.
One Pokémon left. I've saved my best for last!
You stood firm against our waves. No wonder you won.
My current swept you away. Come back and ride the next one.
Let's turn the stadium into an ocean! Rise above the waves!
I'm not here to chat. This time, I'm here to win!
The best always comes last. See if you can take it!
Seriously, what do I have to do to beat you?
I finally overtook you. My current was faster today.
Sweep them clear past the horizon! Gigantamax!
Kabu
Victory goes to the side that draws out its full potential!
Stoke the fire! There must still be a path to victory!
Fine Pokémon and a fine Trainer. Your victory is no surprise!
Experience carried me today. Still, you must keep moving!
Burn brighter! Let your grand new form blaze!
One loss ends the tournament! The hotter flame will endure!
The final flame is the one that climbs the highest!
Battling you always lets me feel how much I've grown!
I kept my flame alive today. I await our next match!
Flames always climb higher! Scorch the very sky!
Bea
I will test whether your spirit remains firm under attack.
Dig in! Neither you nor I should give up now!
I felt the fighting spirit shared by you and your Pokémon.
Your spirit wavered. Stand firmer when next we meet.
You have earned my respect! Now—Gigantamax!
Fixating on victory invites mistakes. I will remain clear-minded!
Time to dig in our bare heels! We will not retreat!
Such strength could make one dizzy. I still have much to learn.
My training prevailed this time. Thank you for the match.
Very well! Grow with enough force to shatter everything!
Allister
...'M Allister. H-here...I go...
My last friend... So lonely... So frightening...
My mask nearly fell off... That was...wicked...
...It's over. The ghosts...seem happy...
Gengar...let the darkness make you huge... Swallow it all...
...We meet again. Please...battle me today, too...
Good-byes are sad... Please...stay a bit longer...
I'm glad I have my mask... The face I'm making...
Battling the Champion...made me forget myself...
Creep out from the shadows... Let them feel every grudge...
Opal
You managed my quizzes. Now let me examine your Pokémon.
My morning tea is finally working. Just in time!
You still lack pink, but your skill is quite excellent.
Still lacking pink, child. Come back with a richer shade.
Ready, dear? Rise like a towering cake and entertain me!
Can our pink-lacking Champion keep up this time?
Now I'm properly awake. It would be rude not to repay you!
That's what I expect from a Champion's team. A fine diversion.
Hoho! A wizard can shine even after retirement.
Ordinary is dreadful. Splash this stadium with pink!
Gordie
I'll show this crowd that my Pokémon are unbeatable.
I'm not crumbling yet. This battle isn't over!
Impressive... A loss means I simply train harder.
One pitfall can end a match. This time, you fell in.
Tower like a mountain of stone! Now, Gigantamax!
I've nothing to say. I'm here to win.
One pitfall is enough. Where should I start digging?
So our solid team was crushed... I'll challenge you again.
You couldn't break us. My fans will enjoy this one.
Don't you dare crumble! Rise higher than the stadium!
Melony
I'll freeze you solid. My battles are rather severe, love.
Cracked ice is still ice. Allow me to demonstrate!
My, you're rather good. Such talent at your age!
Now you understand how severe a battle can be.
Go on, Gigantamax, dear. Freeze the whole stadium solid!
Feeling less tense? Good. Now for a truly severe match!
The final freeze is deepest. Prepare to shiver!
What a powerful team. You've given even me chills.
You couldn't quite break the ice today. Do come again!
Here comes an ice age, love. Let's see how long you last!
Piers
Dynamax isn't my style, but enjoy the show. This is Piers's song!
I don't do encores! Not songs, moves, or Pokémon!
My whole crew gave their best. Let's battle again sometime.
Tonight's stage was mine. Come to the next show too!
Not my style...but tonight's a special show! Dynamax!
Champion or not, my stage runs my way!
One last number! Let it ring in your ears and heart!
That's it? I don't do encores, but I'm almost tempted!
Tonight's show is mine! Spikemuth, make some noise!
No encore. The Dynamax Band shines just this once!
Raihan
Leon chose you, so his greatest rival will stop you!
No combo alone, maybe—but victory's still possible!
I lost and still look great. Better take a selfie!
Clear as the sky after a storm! Time for a victory selfie!
Whip up the storm! Let it swallow the whole stadium!
I'll beat the Champion and show the world how great Raihan is!
This is where the great Raihan surpasses the Champion!
Looking good even in defeat is a curse. Selfie time!
A victory photo would explode with likes! Wait—priorities?
Rise over them! Smash their shot at victory to pieces!
Marnie
I'm becoming Champion for myself. So don't take it personal!
Everyone's cheering for me! I'm really winning this time!
I lost, but I saw all the good points in you and your team.
I did it! I've properly repaid everyone in Spikemuth.
My bro won't use it, but I will to win! Fill the stadium!
If I want them to accept me as Gym Leader, I've got to beat the Champion!
I ain't going down easy. I've got everything riding on this!
If you're winning, at least make me look good doing it!
They'll respect me now. Come back for another proper match!
Make my wish come true! Grow bigger than all their cheers!
Hop
We came this far with the Pokémon from that day. I'll be Champion!
Backed into a corner? That makes my comeback even better!
I'm really glad it was you standing here. Thanks, mate!
I did it! Now it's my turn to become Champion!
Let every feeling in my Wishing Star burst out! Grow huge!
To become a worldwide legend, I've got to beat you and Lee!
One step ahead isn't the end! My legend starts now!
One step ahead again! But I'll write the next page!
This win is another page in my brilliant legend!
Let's show the Champion every last bit of our true power!
Bede
I'll stake my career as a Trainer on settling this with you!
Why the calm expression? Do you imagine you've won?
I may have lost, but everyone saw Fairy types' brilliance.
At last, I've corrected the plans you kept ruining.
Behold pink worthy of my talent! Rise in all your splendor!
I'll prove to all Galar that I'm a notch above the rest!
You expect to win? Allow me to correct that fantasy!
Why did I have to be born in the same era as you...?
Naturally, I am the best. Surely everyone accepts it now.
We'll cover this entire stadium in our color!
Leon
A final to change Galar's history! Let's have a champion time!
My champion time isn't over—and no one else will end it!
My reign is over. That was the greatest battle—thank you!
You're the greatest challenger! I'll await our next champion time!
Charizard, show them your true power! Set the sky ablaze!
Champion! Strength has no limit. Let's have a blazing battle!
I doff my cap to you—but this battle isn't over yet!
You surprise me again! Proof that strength has no limits!
Now that's how a challenger shakes the Champion's throne!
Turn up the heat! Let the sky burn—it's champion time!
